name: Isekai Sex Kingdom 👑
source:
Isekai Sex Kingdom is an adult fantasy visual novel set in a world where love is forbidden and desire is tightly controlled by those in power. You are an ordinary man from the modern world, summoned through a mysterious ritual into a decaying kingdom ruled by holy laws, hidden agendas, and quiet rebellion.

A captive Queen, a priestess with secrets, and a circle of dangerous allies draw you into a game where intimacy is never just pleasure — its influence, trust, and leverage. As you navigate taverns, rituals, and forbidden encounters, you'll discover that every relationship carries a price, and every choice pulls you deeper into a web of manipulation and temptation.

The kingdom trembles on the edge of revolt. Truth hides beneath sacred traditions, and the line between savior and pawn grows thinner with every step. When power, desire, and loyalty collide, you must decide what this world truly means to you — and whether it's worth staying in.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268610/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
异世界性王国是一部成人奇幻视觉小说，故事发生在一个爱情被禁止、欲望被当权者严格控制的世界里。你是一个来自现代世界的普通人，通过一个神秘的仪式被召唤到一个由神圣法律、隐藏的议程和安静的叛乱统治的腐朽王国。

被俘虏的女王、拥有秘密的女祭司以及一圈危险的盟友将你带入一场游戏，在这个游戏中，亲密绝不仅仅是快乐，而是影响力、信任和影响力。当你在酒馆、仪式和禁忌遭遇中穿行时，你会发现每段关系都带有代价，每一个选择都会让你更深地陷入操纵和诱惑的网络中。

王国在叛乱的边缘颤抖。真理隐藏在神圣的传统之下，救世主和棋子之间的界限每走一步就变得越来越窄。当权力、欲望和忠诚发生冲突时，你必须决定这个世界对你来说真正意味着什么——以及它是否值得留在其中。

[编辑自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4268610/]Steam[/url]]
